identity.name: Seamaster Aqua Terra 150M
identity.one_liner: Omega's everyday steel case — no dive bezel, horizontal teak-pattern dial, and the twin-barrel Co-Axial Master Chronometer caliber 8900 shared with the Globemaster.

narrative.story: The Aqua Terra line has been Omega's non-diving 'everyday' Seamaster since 2002, positioned as the one watch that works with a suit and a swim. A case and movement update brought the current horizontal teak-pattern dial and the Co-Axial Master Chronometer caliber 8900 — the same movement architecture used in the Globemaster.
narrative.collector_notes: Omega sells the 41mm Aqua Terra across many closely related reference numbers that differ only in dial color, dial pattern, or strap/bracelet — confirm the exact reference against listing photos rather than relying on the model name alone.
